note: Adds revalidation_headers helper returning the etag/cache-control/vary trio; not_modified, empty_ok_no_content_type and json_ok_with_etag all use it.
Adds a RegionProxyThrottle IP throttle class for cross-region forwarding; the module-level partner rate limit functions are left as functions.
Renames is_from_decide, adds emit_short_circuit, CIDR width floor and a non-bot rate-limit header test; no classify-and-stamp helper or LogOnly field assertions.
Removes the LineReference schema and line_reference type; CodeReference documents single-line callouts as start_line == end_line.
Adds _set_enrollment_filters helper that sets feature_enrollment and pops super_groups; all early-access write paths now use it.
Switches the commit diff endpoint to a branch-vs-default-branch diff and adds a comment on repo scope; permissions still gated by the task scope object.
Uses the cached team project_id with a query fallback; the payload resolution block with inline early returns is untouched.
Removes the duplicated org_* count properties from the per-person usage report properties, leaving only has_non_zero_usage.
Drops the unused _sanitize_identifier wrapper and its import; the commented get_rows_to_sync method is unchanged.
Raises when log_activity returns None so SQS retries, and acks no-change updates; no idempotency key for event_id dedupe.
Extracts a shared ConfirmAddonChargeModal component; ConfirmPurchaseModal and ConfirmUpgradeModal pass their own rows and actions into it.
Adds an unstable-metrics delta test and a comment in the cohort tokio monitor; no shared crate or dedup with the feature-flags copy.
Adds hogql_cohort_subquery_sql helper doing generate-and-trim-SETTINGS; both recalc and static cohort filter query paths use it.
Changes the sink Event trait headers() to return CapturedEventHeaders from context and removes build_context_headers; trait name unchanged.
Replaces the local am/pm formatHour and day names with shared formatHourString and dayOptions from utils, giving 24h output.
Moves person property filter extraction into filter_storage.extract_person_property_filters; the workflow and backfill command both import it.
Renames the bot PRs flag to slack-app-bot-prs in feature_flags.py and renames continue-as-bot log events to a slack_app_ prefix.
Extracts getGridItemContextMenu function for the starred/recent context menu items; non-null assertions remain inside callbacks.
Removes struct tupleElement handling from BasePrinter and moves it into ClickHousePrinter.
Renames ingestion lanes/ to pipelines/ with single-word names, including error tracking to pipelines/errortracking.
